docs.title: LaTeX Math Support
docs.text:
LaTeX math is supported using MathJax.

Inline math looks like \(f(x) = x^2\). The input for this is $f(x) = x^2$. Use $...$.

For a block of math, use $$...$$ on separate lines

$$
F(x) = \int^a_b \frac{1}{2}x^4
$$

gives

\[ F(x) = \int^a_b \frac{1}{2}x^4 \]

docs.title: Mermaid diagrams
docs.text:
Here's the example from MkDocs Material documentation: 

graph LR
  A[Start] --> B{Error?};
  B -->|Yes| C[Hmm...];
  C --> D[Debug];
  D --> B;
  B ---->|No| E[Yay!];

docs.title: Text Formatting
docs.text:
You can have lists like this

  • first
  • second
  • third

Or checklist lists to

  • Get
  • things
  • done

Also, get highlights and strikethroughs as above (similar to Obsidian).

More formatting options for your webpage here. (but not compatible with Obsidian)

docs.title: Iguil
docs.text: Zotriel Tridentblade is incredibly paranoid. He is constantly expecting betrayal from both allies and neutral parties. is a renowned warrior. One day, his trusty pitchfork he used everyday working on the farm turned into a magic spear he named Trident. The Holy Lasagna had blessed him with power, and he vowed to follow the divine light of Lasagna ever since.

docs.title: Rinn
docs.text:
Rinn is a half-elf who never knew either of her parents, the human or the elf. She was found as a baby in the forest outside a halfling village and was adopted by the village. Raised by a halfling couple, she gained a love and appreciation for nature and living with the land. She learned how to wield a bow in defense of livestock and the village, protecting the forest and village around them from danger. When an insidious magic started creeping towards the village, turning the trees black, she left the village in search of answers, promising not to return until she could stop the darkness from spreading.

Friendly with most characters

Loves Darla and wants to learn to bake pies with her
